chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us from his father. He said: Abu Ahmad Muhammad ibn Ziyad al-Azdi narrated to us from Aban ibn Uthman and others from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both). He said:

Whoever completes his fasting with a good saying or a good action, God accepts his fasting from him. So it was said to him: O son of the Messenger of God! What is the good saying? He said: The testimony that there is no god but God; and the good action is giving out the fitra (alms).

key_terms.الفطرة: Zakat al-Fitra — obligatory alms given at the end of Ramadan, typically one sa' of staple food per household member
key_terms.شهادة: Testimony (shahada) — the declaration that there is no god but Allah
key_terms.صيام: Fasting (siyam) — abstaining from food, drink, and other things from dawn to sunset during Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about completing fasting with a good saying and good action?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that to have one's fast accepted by God, one should conclude it with a righteous saying or deed. When asked to specify, he explains that the righteous saying is the shahada (testimony of faith: 'there is no god but Allah'), and the righteous action is paying zakat al-fitra, the obligatory alms given at the end of Ramadan before Eid prayer. This hadith connects the spiritual discipline of fasting with both verbal devotion and charitable action, reflecting the Shi'a emphasis on combining faith with deeds.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Ziyad (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father. He said: Abu Ahmad Muhammad b. Ziyad al-Azdi narrated to us from Aban b. `Uthman and others from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

Whoever completes his fast with a good saying or a good action, Allah will accept his fast. So, it was said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! What is the good saying? He said: The testimony that there is no god but Allah; and the good action is giving out [zakat] al-Fitra.
